nodes.label: Context management for long-running subagents (plugin copy)
nodes.rationale: Rule: summarize everything older than the last 8-10 turns/prompts, capping the running summary at ~12-15% of the context window, and keep the most recent 8-10 turns verbatim — applied to p3-triage (reading prior finalized reports instead of re-deriving findings) and backend (summarizing earlier retrieval/grounding steps on long sessions) so subagent context stays bounded as logs grow without losing prior findings.
